description: Controlled scientific Literature Knowledge Graph ontology covering Entity Types, Directed Relation Types, Attribution Tiers, and Evidence Strength.

USES.description: Study/method uses a material, dataset, instrument, or algorithm.

COMPARES_WITH.description: Explicit controlled comparison reported in the source.

OUTPERFORMS.description: Subject achieves superior performance over baseline object under specified metric/conditions.

UNDERPERFORMS.description: Subject achieves lower performance than object under specified metric/conditions.

SUPPORTS.description: Finding or observation empirically supports a hypothesis or prior claim.

CONTRADICTS.description: Finding explicitly conflicts with or refutes another claim or study.

MEASURES.description: Entity or experimental run reports a specific quantitative metric.

INCREASES.description: Factor increases target property/metric under stated conditions.

DECREASES.description: Factor decreases target property/metric under stated conditions.

DEPENDS_ON.description: Outcome depends on operating parameter or precondition.

INSTANCE_OF.description: Links a paper-specific physical sample, model checkpoint, or dataset split to a shared conceptual term without conflating conditions/results.

EVALUATED_ON.description: Method/material evaluated on benchmark task, reaction, or cohort.
